- Elif–Finn–Gus (Elif immediately before Finn, Finn immediately before Gus)
- Ben–Hana (Ben immediately before Hana)
- Ann–Ivo (Ann immediately before Ivo)

**Ordering constraints:**
- Cara before Ann
- Cara before Dev
- Dev before Ben
- Ben before Finn
- Elif before Ann
- Elif before Gus (satisfied by block)
- Gus before Ivo
- Hana and Ivo at least three slots apart

From Dev < Ben < Finn, and Ben–Hana consecutive, Hana sits right after Ben, so Hana is before Elif (since Ben < Elif < Finn). Thus the order is:

Cara < Dev < Ben < Hana < Elif < Finn < Gus

Ann must be after Elif and before Ivo, with Ann–Ivo consecutive. Gus < Ivo, so Ann–Ivo must come after Gus (since Ann is after Elif, and the only place left after Gus is at the end). So:

Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo

Check Hana (slot 4) and Ivo (slot 9): distance 5 ≥ 3. ✓

All constraints hold.
